records.title: Harnessing generative AI for predicting and optimizing antimicrobial peptides against drug-resistant infections
records.reason: The title/abstract concern image-quality assessment, quantum-assisted RF fingerprint training, or peptide design and the linked lineage is contextual, but publisher DOI primary full text could not be retrieved; cannot rule out a concrete systems tie from abstract alone.

records.title: HarnessAPI: A Skill-First Framework for Unified Streaming APIs and MCP Tools
records.reason: HarnessAPI unifies skill-first streaming APIs/MCP tools; its evaluation measures framework boilerplate and compatibility rather than model-serving latency/throughput, so the serving lineage is only contextual.

records.title: MARGIN: Runtime Confidence Calibration for Multi-Agent Foundation Model Coordination
records.reason: MARGIN calibrates confidence online with EWMA bands, no retraining/model access and negligible (~100 FLOP/update) overhead. It could affect agent coordination/routing decisions but the paper does not establish lower inference calls, latency, or resource use.

records.title: Trusted Weights, Treacherous Optimizations? Optimization-Triggered Backdoor Attacks on LLMs
records.reason: Studies optimization-triggered backdoor/security risk in LLMs; compiler optimization is the attack trigger, not an inference-efficiency improvement.

records.title: Instant GPU Efficiency Visibility at Fleet Scale
records.reason: Provides fleet-scale GPU efficiency monitoring/visibility for AI workloads, with system-level efficiency relevance, but the reviewed work is centered on monitoring/training workloads rather than a concrete LLM inference-serving optimization.
